title: Absolute Difference
statement: Design a unit that computes the absolute difference between two unsigned 8-bit values. The output should always be nonnegative and equal to |a - b|. This combinational block is useful in error detection and distance metrics.
module_signature: module absolute_difference(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, output reg [7:0] diff);
behavior: diff equals a - b when a >= b.
diff equals b - a when b > a.
Output must be nonnegative and unsigned.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use sequential storage or clocks.
hint: Use a comparator to choose the subtraction direction.
